g.text: Cut VUSB jumper to prevent motors and servos from being powered by USB
Cut PWR jumpers to remove power LEDs
Cut VIN_MEAS jumper to disconnect from IO28
Cut I2C jumper to remove pullup resistors
Cut USER_BTN jumper to disconnect from IO22
Default I2C address: 0x6B Open IMU_ADR jumper: 0x6A
Cut MOT_MODE jumpers to change from PH/EN mode to PWM mode
Connect S1 to GND to enable VIN
